title: API Rate Limiter
brief:
As an API owner, I want each client limited to a number of requests per minute, so that no single client can overload the gateway.

Acceptance criteria:
- A client that is over its limit gets 429 with a Retry-After header, and its request is not handled.
- Clients are limited separately: one client over its limit does not slow down another.
- A client gets through again as soon as its earlier accepted requests have left the one-minute window, even if it kept retrying in the meantime.

steps.summary: Add the rate limit types and defaults
Add the 429 helper and client identification
Add the gateway filter, unit tests and README docs

probes.question: How many requests per minute does a client get by default?
A request has the headers x-forwarded-for: "10.0.0.1, 10.0.0.2" and x-real-ip: "10.0.0.9". Which client id does it get?
A limiter allows 2 requests per 1000 ms. A client sends 2 requests at 0 ms, 2 more at 100 ms and 200 ms (both rejected), then one at 1000 ms. Is the last one allowed?

items.question: A limiter allows 2 requests per 1000 ms. Requests at 0 ms and 500 ms are allowed. Is a request at exactly 1000 ms allowed?
options: Allowed: the request from 0 ms no longer counts
Rejected: the request from 0 ms still counts
Allowed only after the limiter is reset

items.question: A client is over its limit and keeps retrying every 100 ms. When does it get through again?
options: Once its oldest accepted request has left the window
Only after it stops retrying for a full window

items.question: A limiter is created with a limit of 0. What happens when a client sends requests?
options: The first request is allowed, the ones after it are rejected
Creating the limiter fails with a validation error

items.question: Through the gateway, a client is rejected. It then waits exactly as long as its Retry-After header says, sending nothing in between. Does its next request get through?
options: Only if no other client sent a request meanwhile
The rejection has no Retry-After header

items.question: Two different clients send requests through the gateway, neither with any proxy header. Are they limited separately?
options: No: both count as the same client ("unknown")
Yes: each one is limited on its own
The gateway rejects requests without proxy headers
